transitions: [iacode] --- stack: build and start an isolated stack, then wait for real health
[iacode] --- integration: the backend suite against the real services
[iacode] --- infra: our configuration of each service, exercised live
[iacode] --- smoke: the API, the web shell, the observability stack and a workflow
[iacode] --- gateway-smoke: the Model Gateway against the real configured provider
[iacode] --- agent-runtime-smoke: the Agent Runtime against the real provider, through the gateway
[iacode] --- agent-durability: a run waiting for a tool survives a real worker restart
[iacode] --- agent-cancellation: a paused run is cancelled, stays cancelled and refuses a late result
[iacode] --- agent-deadline: a run that is alive and going nowhere is ended by its own deadline
[iacode] --- sandbox-integration: the sandbox's store and artifact sink against the real services
[iacode] --- quality-integration: quality lifecycle and immutable evidence against the real services
[iacode] --- quality-pass: a passing fixture derives PASS through the complete Quality Engine
[iacode] --- quality-fail: a failing fixture preserves its failed check, finding and evidence
[iacode] --- quality-iacode: the committed IACode tree is evaluated by its canonical profile
[iacode] --- quality-reproduction: stored inputs reproduce an equivalent result under the same plan identity
[iacode] --- quality-recovery: a quality run survives evaluator restart without duplicate results
[iacode] --- quality-cancellation: cancellation waits for sandbox cleanup and remains fail-closed
[iacode] --- quality-timeout: policy-owned deadlines record timeout evidence and a FAIL verdict
[iacode] --- sandbox-coding: a coding team fixes a synthetic repository in a real sandbox; the host is untouched
[iacode] --- sandbox-timeout: a command past its timeout is stopped and the run carries on
[iacode] --- sandbox-cancellation: a run cancelled during a long command stops it and leaves no sandbox
[iacode] --- sandbox-recovery: a restarted sandbox service keeps the run's session and its workspace
[iacode] --- sandbox-tool-result-origin: a result posted to the API for a sandboxed request is refused, and the agent receives the sandbox's own
[iacode] --- quality-false-pass: the Gate 4 false-PASS battery rejects every mandatory mutation
[iacode] --- backup: backup, restore into a disposable target, verified read-back
[iacode] --- dependency-scan: known vulnerabilities in the pinned dependencies
[iacode] --- native-client-installation: fresh actual VSIX installation, workspace trust and owned storage/process cleanup
[iacode] --- desktop-client-e2e: fresh CLI/native recovery through real hardened provider/sandbox/quality workflows
[iacode] --- experience-store-e2e: real authenticated source-bound capture, rights, restart, corruption and retention
[iacode] --- knowledge-engine-e2e: real governed source ingestion, measured retrieval, citations and invalidation
[iacode] --- dependency-failure: liveness holds, readiness refuses, both recover
[iacode] --- fresh-install: a complete installation from no volumes at all
